title: feat(app-shell): a row-table page block lists the rows a page api binding answers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBueky5afd2NHME9E1M7DVw)_

Fixes #31856

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — skills/ teaches no product block (git grep tile-grid|usage-bar skills/ = 0)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:控制台新增一个页面块 `row-table`,把页面 `api` 绑定读到的一组数据画成表格:列在元数据里声明(字段路径、标题、格式:文本 / 日期时间 / 枚举标签),每一行都画,没有数据时显示空状态文字。
- **为什么改**:云端的 AI 员工页(cloud#4073)和 AI 调用追踪页(cloud#4058)要列出接口返回的多行数据,现在只能用固定条数的文字行凑合;这个块让它们按真实行数显示。
- **风险与回滚**:纯新增,没有页面在用,现有块和页面不变;不改 `@objectstack/spec`,SDUI 清单不动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/productBlocks.tsx`(`readRowTable` 的拒收判定与 `rowTableCell`)、`ui/packages/types/src/zod/product-blocks.zod.ts`(`RowTableColumnSchema` 的严格校验)、`ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`(命名空间计数 306→307)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/__tests__/rowTable-31856.test.tsx packages/types/src/__tests__/product-block-arms-12197.test.ts`,预期两个文件全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: the `row-table` block**, the sixth product-page block beside `hero`, `stat`, `usage-bar`, `checklist` and `tile-grid`, registered under the `app-shell` namespace with the bare `row-table` as its authorable key and the same `API_BINDING_INPUT`.
  - `rows`: a list, or one whole `${…}` hole naming a list in the bound `data`, as `tile-grid`'s `items`. Every row is drawn, in order, with no cap.
  - `columns`: `{ path, label, format?, enum? }`, drawn in the order written. The keys are `resultDialog.fields`' vocabulary (`path` / `label` / `format`, `text` shared); `datetime` and `enum` are this block's own formats. `path` is read per row with `selectElementApiPath` (`@object-ui/react`), the binding's own path reader.
  - `text` draws as written (an object as compact JSON); `datetime` goes through `formatDateTime(value, { locale: useDisplayLocale(), style: 'compact' })` from `@object-ui/core`, the `datetime` field cell's face, in the display zone the host declared, else the viewer's; `enum` draws the label `enum: { value: label }` names, and a value the map does not name as written.
  - A field the row lacks, `null` or `''` draws `—`. An empty list draws `emptyLabel`, else the existing `table.noRows` key. No new i18n key.
  - A `rows` hole that resolves to anything but a list, or a column the block cannot draw (no `path`, an unknown `format`, `enum` with no map), draws an error face with the binding's own title (`element.component.apiUnreadable`) and a sentence naming the input. Never the empty state.
- **`@object-ui/types`: its arm.** `RowTableBlockSchema` and `RowTableColumnSchema`, with the TS twins `RowTableBlockSchema`, `RowTableBlockProps` and `RowTableColumn`, joining `ProductBlockComponentSchema`, so `objectui validate` claims the type. The arm is strict: an unknown `format`, an `enum` column with no map, a map on a column that is not `enum`, a `path` that is not a dotted path, an undeclared key (the card's prose word `header` included) and an empty `columns` are refused. `dataSource` is the spec's `ElementApiDataSourceSchema`, by reference. The mirror-parity pin registers both pairs (199 → 201) as spec-derived.
- **`@object-ui/cli`**: `known-schema-types.ts` regenerated (`row-table`, `app-shell:row-table`). The 10859 ratchet's namespaced count moves 306 → 307 for `app-shell:row-table`, a named stopgap raise of that one key, written beside the objectui#13301 raise it follows: the namespaced twin is refused at `type` by design so the bare key stays the one authorable spelling. Both `productBlocks-namespace-13301` lists (app-shell and cli) gain `row-table`.
- **Docs**: the app-shell README block table and a `row-table` example, `content/docs/frontend/data-source.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (the block lists that take the `api` binding).
- **No `@objectstack/spec` change.** The type parses through `PageComponentSchema.type`'s open string arm, and `component-type-unknown` claims only colon namespaces. The SDUI manifest does not move: `@object-ui/app-shell` is not one of the manifest generator's registry modules (`node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0, 106 components).

## Tests

- `rowTable-31856.test.tsx` (new, eight cases, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the host `apiFetch`): the registration's inputs; every bound row in authored column order; enum labels and an unnamed value drawn raw; datetime in a pinned display zone (`Asia/Tokyo`) equal to `formatDateTime`'s face; `—` for a missing and a `null` field; the authored empty label and the bundle's; a non-list hole draws the error face and not the empty state; an unknown format draws the error face.
- `product-block-arms-12197.test.ts`: the `row-table` fixture joins the shared accept / content-channel / undeclared-prop loop, plus six `row-table` cases (literal rows, unknown format, enum without a map and a map without enum, a non-dotted path, `header`, empty columns and a partial hole).

<details><summary>Runs (branch on 1ff1d45d; head 5e6d804d merges main a57a007d, which moves no `packages/spec` or `ui/packages` file, so the runs below stand)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 39 passed (39)` (re-run after the last source commit).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/`: `Test Files 267 passed (267)`, `Tests 2038 passed (2038)`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/`: `Test Files 389 passed (389)`, `Tests 10489 passed (10489)`; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (the mirror-parity type legs): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/cli/`: `Test Files 31 passed (31)`, `Tests 420 passed (420)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, test files included): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 5027 passed | 2 skipped`.
- ui censuses, each exit 0: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-snippets` (537 of 537 blocks), `check:doc-examples`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 69 families derived, 69 run, each exit 0 (`--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; the list is identical after the merge of main). `check:skill-examples` first answered exit 3 (client SDK unbuilt) and was re-run green after building it; `check:query-options-erasure` was re-run green with a longer timeout.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- `const rows = props.rows;` → `const rows = Array.isArray(props.rows) ? props.rows : [];` (the non-array guard made an empty list): exactly "refuses a hole that resolves to a non-list with the error panel, never the empty state" goes red, `1 failed | 7 passed`; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Consumers:** cloud#4073 (the AI workforce page, which replaces its capped `element:text` rows with this block) and cloud#4058 (the AI call trace page). Neither is in this repo; no page here places the block yet.
- **`os validate` does not judge the block's `properties`**, as for every product block: there is no `ComponentPropsMap` row, so the strict arm is judged by `objectui validate` / `safeValidateSchema`. The seat ruled this a family question for all six blocks, not this card's.
- **The error face is drawn by the block, not by `ElementDataSourceErrorPanel`**: that panel marks a consumer of the object-binding gate (`check:element-data-source-declaration` refused the first draft), which an `api`-bound product block is not. It uses the same classes, `role="alert"` and the binding's own title key.
- **NOT MEASURED locally: `check:sdui-registration-pins`** (it weighs a built console bundle; CI's Build & E2E UI builds it). `check:type-check-debt` ran under the verify lock: exit 0.
